Earthquake
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When a sandstorm is caused.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Lowers the target’s Defense by 1 stat rank. Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 1 rank when its attack hits a target that is trapped.

Earthquake
moves.description: Become Mega Garchomp until the end of battle. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks.

passives.name: Earth Myth
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 20%. The more allied sync pairs with the Ground theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 30%, and the maximum damage reduction is 26%.)

passives.name: Earth Judgment
passives.description: Raises the Ground Type Rebuff of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank the first time the user enters a battle each battle. Lowers the Ground Type Rebuff of all opposing sync pairs by 1 rank the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Myth Archeologist
passives.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Ground Zone when the user causes a sandstorm. (A Ground Zone powers up Ground-type attacks.) Extends the duration of a sandstorm when a sandstorm is caused while the user is on the field. Extends the duration of the Ground Zone when the zone turns into a Ground Zone while the user is on the field.

passives.name: Mutual Trust
passives.description: The user’s moves never miss. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with the user’s following attacks become critical hits: Pokémon’s moves or sync move. Protects the user from damage from a sandstorm.

passives.name: Unbending Pride
passives.description: Reduces the sync move countdown by 1 the first time the user’s Pokémon uses a status move each battle. Raises the user’s Attack by 6 stat ranks the first time its Pokémon uses a status move each battle.
